description: Manual analysis of 200 common mutants (Block, Spec, and Spec_bva scope). Classifies each as incompetent, equivalent, killed, killed_timeout, or survived.

methodology.incompetent: Mutant does not compile (resolution/type errors). Neither tool can kill it meaningfully.
methodology.equivalent: Semantically identical to original. No test can distinguish them.
methodology.killed: Killed by test assertion failure (FAIL) or build error against mutant.
methodology.killed_timeout: Runtime infinite loop confirmed by manual inspection. Timeout folded into kill.
methodology.survived: Real bug that escapes both tools on the realistically-killable set.
